name: CONV-D
save: Chrome downloads saveAs dialog; user chooses the local destination
activation: Dashboard button Ativar CONV toggles convDEnabled in chrome.storage.local
behavior: button injected into supported conversation pages and remounted after SPA/DOM navigation
url_module: CONVERSAS POR URL validates HTTPS AI conversation URLs, opens the authenticated page, and hands extraction to CONV-D
repository_target: optional informational GitHub repository URL; no force-push or silent credential handling
identity: exports preserve detected user/assistant roles and platform message IDs when the platform exposes them; no private account ID is fabricated
format_note: DOC uses Word-compatible HTML and XLS uses Excel SpreadsheetML so the files remain portable without native executors
security: No Native Messaging, no access-token storage, no forced Git operations
